title: Vampire Vape Pinkman Blue Razz Flavour Concentrate 30ml
description: Vampire Vape Pinkman Blue Razz Flavour Concentrate allows DIY mixers to create their own custom e-liquid, infusing the legendary Pinkman profile with a sharp, fruity twist. This concentrate combines the iconic Pinkman base of sweet Red Berries and subtle Citrus notes with the bold, tangy taste of Blue Raspberry. The result is a complex and layered flavour profile where the Strawberry and Raspberry foundation is lifted by the zesty kick of Blue Razz. It offers a balance of sweetness and sharpness, making it an excellent choice for vapers who enjoy a vibrant fruit mix that doesn't become overpowering. Designed for use in DIY e-liquids, this 30ml bottle contains 100% PG-suspended flavour concentrate. It is not ready to vape and must be diluted with your preferred VG/PG base mix. Vampire Vape recommends a mix ratio of 15-20% depending on your desired flavour strength. This high-quality concentrate is made in the UK and serves as a versatile ingredient for both new and experienced mixers looking to tailor their vaping experience. Please note: This flavour concentrate is not intended to be vaped on its own. These concentrates are for personal use and are not to be used for commercial purposes. Details 100% PG Based 0mg E-liquid Add to a VG/PG base e-liquid mix Mix your own e-liquids, just the way you like Made in the UK
